name: San José (Costa Rica)
description: A blue field with a green stripe along the base, charged across the centre with a row of eleven white five-pointed stars.
history: Adopted by Municipal Decree No. 7 of 27 April 2006 after a competition called by Decree No. 2 of 31 May 2005; the design is by Walter Rojas Hidalgo.

features.symbolism: blue for the sky, green for hope
the eleven districts of the canton; white for transparency
